Get TPBL Team Shots

Source: R/tpbl.R
tpbl_team_shots.Rd

Every field-goal attempt of one team in one division with its court position (optionally per quarter).

Endpoint: GET https://api.tpbl.basketball/api/divisions/{division_id}/teams/{team_id}/shooting-spots

Usage

tpbl_team_shots(division_id, team_id, rounds = NULL)

Arguments

division_id

Required. TPBL division id (one competition phase of one season: 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 = 2024-25 preseason, regular season, playoffs, postseason challenge, finals; 8, 9, 11, 12, 35 = 2025-26; 655, 656 = 2026-27); division_id in tpbl_divisions. Not the GoHoops division id.

team_id

Required. TPBL team id (the franchise, 2-8, stable across seasons); team_id in tpbl_teams. Not the GoHoops id.

rounds

Quarter filter: a quarter number or a vector of them (1-4, 5 and 6 for overtimes); the runtime sends it as the API's repeatable rounds[]. NULL (the default) for all quarters.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Every field-goal attempt of one team in one division with its court position (optionally per quarter). An empty answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py tpbl_team_shots):

col_nametypedescription
division_idintegerTPBL division id (key space: TPBL divisions, one competition phase of one season; 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 = 2024-25, 8, 9, 11, 12, 35 = 2025-26, 655, 656 = 2026-27): the {division_id} of every division route. Not the GoHoops division id.
team_idintegerTPBL team id (key space: TPBL teams = franchises, 2-8 so far; stable across seasons): the {team_id} of the division team routes. Not the GoHoops franchise id and not the squad id.
roundscharacterThe quarter filter asked for, comma-separated ('1' or '1,2'); null when all quarters were asked.
is_madelogicalTrue when the shot went in.
point_xintegerShot position in MILLIMETRES, 0-28000 along the court length (a 28 m court). The hoops sit at x = 1575 (offense_basket 0) and x = 26425 (offense_basket 1), y = 7500. Verified on 2,971 shots of one team: the made rate within 1.2 m of the hoop is 62-71 %. Which baseline is x = 0 is unverified.
point_yintegerShot position in MILLIMETRES, 0-15000 across the court (a 15 m court). The hoops sit at x = 1575 (offense_basket 0) and x = 26425 (offense_basket 1), y = 7500. The direction of y is unverified.
offense_basketintegerBasket the team attacked: 0 = the hoop at x = 1575, 1 = the hoop at x = 26425.

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these are the routes the tpbl.basketball site's own front end calls on api.tpbl.basketball (read from its JavaScript bundle). The API is keyless and needs no headers; tpbl.basketball/robots.txt answers 200 with an empty body. The runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Coverage: three seasons so far (2024-25 = season 2025 to 2026-27 = season 2027). There is NO play-by-play route; the two shot lists carry court coordinates only, with no shooter, game, quarter or time. Names (teams with their sponsor, venues, players, referees) are Traditional Chinese; the column descriptions translate the codes.

  • Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26). The API keys a season by its own small integer (1, 2, 3 = 2024-25, 2025-26, 2026-27); the runtime reads tpbl_seasons once per session and sends that id. A year the list lacks is hoopR_no_data.

  • Ids: every route takes TPBL's own ids (season, division, team, game, player); the gohoops_* ids belong to GoHoops, the stats platform behind the league, and are echoed beside them. The box score keys its players by gohoops_roster_id (a person registered with one squad in one season), not by the TPBL player id: join tpbl_box_players to tpbl_roster on gohoops_roster_id. Every id is an integer. tipoff is a POSIXct in Asia/Taipei (the API sends naive Taiwan-local times).

  • Finished games only: the game wrappers first read the game detail (cached per session) and refuse (hoopR_asset_fetch) a game that is not COMPLETED or still live; the box-score wrappers also refuse a stats body whose teams (in home / away order), final scores, quarter count or player points disagree with it. The season game list, the roster and the player game log are checked against the object asked for; the two shot lists name no team, player or division in the body, so only their shape and court bounds are checked. tpbl_games(verify = TRUE) also checks every division's completed games against its standings (falling back to the team-filtered lists for a division whose standings answer empty, as the 2024-25 playoffs do).

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, a season the API does not list, an empty list such as the standings of a playoff division), hoopR_bad_request (a non-integer id or season, HTTP 400 / 422, an invalid verify or rounds, raised before the request where it can be) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other failure: a non-2xx after retries, a non-JSON body, an error envelope, an unfinished game, a body that disagrees with the object asked for). HTTP 500 is retried on every route except the player game log, where an unknown division_id answers 500 deterministically: it fails after one request. Wrappers raise; they never warn and return an empty frame.

 tpbl_team_shots(division_id = 2, team_id = 4, rounds = 1)
